findings.finding: Both production methods implement the requested calendar-neutral ordering without changing the existing calendar-sensitive comparisons. LocalDate compares DaysSinceEpoch values. LocalDateTime compares the physical date first by calling the new LocalDate method, then compares LocalTime only when the days match. The changes do not convert through DateTime or mutate either calendar.
